        from app.db.models import TrainingSession
        prepared = await session.get(TrainingSession, preparedSessionId)
        if prepared is None or prepared.user_id != user.id or prepared.scene_id != sceneId:
            raise AppError(404, "SESSION_NOT_FOUND", "准备会话不存在")
        if prepared.current_round:
            saved_id = await create_voice_session(session, user.id, sceneId, [turn.model_dump() for turn in parsed], channel="VIDEO" if video is not None else channelHint, prepared_session_id=preparedSessionId)
            return ok({"id": saved_id, "delivery": prepared.delivery, "recordingUrl": storage.url_of(prepared.recording_path)})
    delivery: dict | None = None
    recording_path: str | None = None
    channel = channelHint
    if video is not None:
        # 实时视频房间：浏览器同时录音与录像，这里保存整段视频并做人脸技术指标
        suffix = Path(video.filename or "room.webm").suffix or ".webm"
        handle = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=suffix, delete=False)
        try:
            shutil.copyfileobj(video.file, handle)
            handle.close()
            from app.features.video.metrics import analyze_video

            delivery = await asyncio.to_thread(analyze, handle.name)
            vision = await asyncio.to_thread(analyze_video, handle.name)
            recording_path = storage.save_file(Path(handle.name), suffix)
        finally:
            Path(handle.name).unlink(missing_ok=True)
        channel = "VIDEO"
        if delivery is None:
            delivery = {}
        marks = _turn_marks(parsed)
        segments: list[dict] = []
        if marks and recording_path:
            from app.features.video.segments import split_segments

            segments = await asyncio.to_thread(
                split_segments,
                storage.path_of(recording_path),
                marks,
                settings.recording_dir_path,
                storage.signed_url,
            )
        delivery = {**delivery, "vision": vision, "engine": engine, "marks": marks, "segments": segments}
    elif audio is not None:
        suffix = Path(audio.filename or "voice.webm").suffix or ".webm"
        handle = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=suffix, delete=False)
        try:
            shutil.copyfileobj(audio.file, handle)
            handle.close()
            delivery = await asyncio.to_thread(analyze, handle.name)
            recording_path = storage.save_file(Path(handle.name), suffix)
        finally:
            Path(handle.name).unlink(missing_ok=True)

    require_verified(user)
    session_id = await create_voice_session(
        session,
        user.id,
        sceneId,
        [turn.model_dump() for turn in parsed],
        duration_seconds=durationSeconds,
        delivery=delivery or None,
        engine=engine if engine in {"doubao", "pipeline"} else "doubao",
        channel=channel,
        recording_path=recording_path,
        prepared_session_id=preparedSessionId,
    )
    return ok({"id": session_id, "delivery": delivery or None, "recordingUrl": storage.url_of(recording_path)})


@router.websocket("/ws/pipeline")
async def voice_pipeline_ws(client: WebSocket, sceneId: str | None = None, depth: str = "STANDARD", sessionId: str | None = None) -> None:
    """pipecat 引擎：本地 Whisper + DeepSeek + 系统语音。"""
    await client.accept()
    user_id = await authorize(client)
    if user_id is None:
        return

    try:
        from pipecat.pipeline.runner import PipelineRunner

        from app.features.voice.pipeline import build_pipeline
    except ImportError as exc:
        # 依赖没装齐也要给出可读原因，而不是断成一条没有理由的连接
        await close_pipeline_failed(client, exc)
        return

    if VOICE_SLOTS.locked() and VOICE_SLOTS._value <= 0:  # noqa: SLF001
        await client.close(code=BUSY_CLOSE_CODE, reason=BUSY_REASON)
        return
    instructions = (
        "你是一名中文面试官，正在做模拟面试。候选人说完后，先用一句话回应，再追问一个具体问题，"
        "每次不超过 60 字，不要自问自答，不要长篇独白。"
    )
    if depth == "THREE_LAYER":
        instructions += " 本场启用三层追问：先确认基础知识与事实，再让候选人比较方案优劣，最后给出复杂或异常场景；每轮只推进一层。"
    elif depth == "PRESSURE":
        instructions += " 本场是压力面：节奏快、连续追问证据和数字，不接客套，但保持专业尊重。"
    opening = "你好，我是今天的面试官，请先做个自我介绍。"
    if sceneId:
        from app.db.base import session_factory
        from app.features.scenes.service import get_scene

        async with session_factory() as session:
            try:
                scene = await get_scene(session, sceneId, user_id)
            except AppError:
                scene = None
            if scene is not None:
                instructions = (
                    f"{instructions}\n本场场景：{scene.title}（{scene.category}）。"
                    f"你的角色：{scene.role_name}。背景：{scene.background}。目标：{scene.goal}。"
                )
                opening = scene.opening_line or f"你好，我是{scene.role_name}，我们先简单聊一聊。"

    if sessionId:
        from app.features.training.preparation import interview_context_data
        from app.db.base import session_factory
        async with session_factory() as db:
            try:
                context = await interview_context_data(db, user_id, sessionId)
            except AppError:
                await client.close(code=4003, reason="准备会话不可用")
                return
        instructions, opening = context["instructions"], context["openingLine"]
    await VOICE_SLOTS.acquire()
    try:
        task = build_pipeline(client, instructions, opening=opening)
        runner = PipelineRunner(handle_sigint=False, check_dangling_tasks=False)
        await runner.run(task)
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        return
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        await close_pipeline_failed(client, exc)
    finally:
        VOICE_SLOTS.release()

"""把一次语音对练的转写文本落成一个训练会话，接上现有评分链路。"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from sqlalchemy import delete, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.errors import AppError

from app.db.models import Message, Scene, TrainingSession
from app.features.scenes.service import get_scene
from app.features.scenes.taxonomy import normalize_bank
from app.features.training.transcript import transcript_delivery
from app.features.training.question_coverage import covered_question_indexes


def _coverage(scene: Scene, questions: list[str], bank_override: list[dict] | None = None) -> int:
    """Use the same actual-question rule as text interviews and reports."""
    bank = normalize_bank(bank_override if bank_override is not None else scene.question_bank)
    return len(covered_question_indexes(bank, questions))


def _clean_turns(turns: list[dict]) -> tuple[list[tuple[str, str]], list[dict]]:
    """丢掉没有回答的轮次，返回 (问答对, 转写时间戳)。"""
    cleaned: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    transcript = []
    for turn in turns:
        question = str(turn.get("question", "")).strip()
        answer = str(turn.get("answer", "")).strip()
        if not answer:
            continue
        cleaned.append((question or "请继续。", answer))
        transcript.append({"roundNo": len(cleaned), "startMs": turn.get("startMs"), "endMs": turn.get("endMs")})
    return cleaned, transcript


async def _same_dialogue_saved(session: AsyncSession, prepared: TrainingSession, cleaned: list[tuple[str, str]], channel: str) -> bool:
    """预建会话已有内容时，判断是否就是同一场对话的重复保存。"""
    existing = (await session.scalars(select(Message).where(Message.session_id == prepared.id).order_by(Message.round_no, Message.created_at))).all()
    old = [(next((m.content for m in existing if m.round_no == index and m.speaker == "AI"), ""), next((m.content for m in existing if m.round_no == index and m.speaker == "USER"), "")) for index in range(1, prepared.current_round + 1)]
    return old == cleaned and prepared.channel == channel


async def _adopt_prepared_session(
    session: AsyncSession, user_id: str, scene: Scene, prepared_session_id: str, training: TrainingSession,
    cleaned: list[tuple[str, str]], channel: str, duration_seconds: int | None, recording_path: str | None,
) -> tuple[TrainingSession, str | None]:
    """复用进房间时预建的会话。返回 (要落库的会话, 已保存时直接可返回的会话 id)。"""
    prepared = await session.get(TrainingSession, prepared_session_id)
    if prepared is None or prepared.user_id != user_id or prepared.scene_id != scene.id:
        raise AppError(404, "SESSION_NOT_FOUND", "准备会话不存在")
    if prepared.current_round:
        if await _same_dialogue_saved(session, prepared, cleaned, channel):
            return prepared, prepared.id
        raise AppError(409, "SESSION_ALREADY_SAVED", "本场面试已保存，请查看训练记录")
    if prepared.status != "ACTIVE":
        raise AppError(409, "SESSION_ALREADY_SAVED", "本场面试已保存，请查看训练记录")
    await session.execute(delete(Message).where(Message.session_id == prepared.id))
    prepared.current_round = len(cleaned)
    prepared.covered_count = _coverage(scene, [question for question, _ in cleaned], prepared.question_plan)
    prepared.channel = channel
    prepared.duration_seconds = duration_seconds
    prepared.delivery = {**(prepared.delivery or {}), **(training.delivery or {})}
    prepared.recording_path = recording_path
    return prepared, None


def _dialogue_messages(training_id: str, cleaned: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> list[Message]:
    messages = []
    for index, (question, answer) in enumerate(cleaned, start=1):
        messages.append(Message(session_id=training_id, round_no=index, speaker="AI", content=question))
        messages.append(Message(session_id=training_id, round_no=index, speaker="USER", content=answer))
    return messages


async def create_voice_session(
    session: AsyncSession,
    user_id: str,
    scene_id: str,
    turns: list[dict],
    duration_seconds: int | None = None,
    delivery: dict | None = None,
    engine: str = "doubao",
    channel: str = "VOICE",
    recording_path: str | None = None,
    prepared_session_id: str | None = None,
) -> str:
    scene = await get_scene(session, scene_id, user_id)
    if not turns:
        raise AppError(422, "VOICE_SESSION_EMPTY", "这次通话没有可评分的对话内容")
    cleaned, transcript = _clean_turns(turns)
    if not cleaned:
        raise AppError(422, "VOICE_SESSION_EMPTY", "这次通话没有可评分的回答")

    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    training = TrainingSession(
        user_id=user_id,
        scene_id=scene.id,
        status="ACTIVE",
        stage="CLOSING",
        current_round=len(cleaned),
        covered_count=_coverage(scene, [question for question, _ in cleaned]),
        question_plan=normalize_bank(scene.question_bank),
        channel=channel,
        duration_seconds=duration_seconds,
        delivery={**(delivery or {}), "engine": engine},
        recording_path=recording_path,
        started_at=now,
    )
    from app.features.training.rubrics import new_context
    training.assessment_context = new_context(scene, normalize_bank(scene.question_bank))
    if prepared_session_id:
        training, saved_id = await _adopt_prepared_session(
            session, user_id, scene, prepared_session_id, training, cleaned, channel, duration_seconds, recording_path
        )
        if saved_id:
            return saved_id
    session.add(training)
    await session.flush()

    messages = _dialogue_messages(training.id, cleaned)
    session.add_all(messages)
    await session.flush()
    training.delivery = transcript_delivery({**(training.delivery or {}), "transcript": transcript}, messages, channel)
    await session.commit()
    return training.id

import asyncio
import json
import re
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from time import monotonic
from typing import Any

import httpx

from app.core.config import Settings, settings
from app.core.metrics import incr_event


def record_usage(usage) -> None:
    """Only provider-reported tokens; unavailable usage is not zero cost."""
    if not isinstance(usage, dict):
        incr_event('llm_usage', 'unreported')
        return
    reported = False
    for field, label in [('prompt_tokens', 'input'), ('completion_tokens', 'output')]:
        value = usage.get(field)
        if type(value) is int and value >= 0:
            incr_event('llm_tokens', label, value)
            reported = True
    incr_event('llm_usage', 'reported' if reported else 'unreported')


async def _with_retry(call, *, attempts: int = 3, base_delay: float = 0.6):
    """网络抖动重试：只对连接类错误与超时重试。"""
    last_error = None
    for index in range(attempts):
        try:
            return await call()
        except (httpx.ConnectError, httpx.ConnectTimeout, httpx.ReadTimeout, httpx.RemoteProtocolError) as exc:
            last_error = exc
            if index < attempts - 1:
                await asyncio.sleep(base_delay * (index + 1))
    raise last_error


class LlmGateway:
    def __init__(
        self,
        config: Settings = settings,
        transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.config = config
        self._transport = transport
        self._health_lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self._health_status = "unconfigured" if not self.configured else "unknown"
        self._health_checked_at = 0.0

    @property
    def configured(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.config.llm_api_key)

    async def health_status(self, *, force: bool = False) -> str:
        if not self.configured:
            return "unconfigured"

        now = monotonic()
        if (
            not force
            and self._health_checked_at
            and now - self._health_checked_at < self.config.llm_healthcheck_ttl_seconds
        ):
            return self._health_status

        async with self._health_lock:
            now = monotonic()
            if (
                not force
                and self._health_checked_at
                and now - self._health_checked_at < self.config.llm_healthcheck_ttl_seconds
            ):
                return self._health_status

            status = "error"
            try:
                payload = {
                    "model": self.config.llm_model,
                    "messages": [
                        {
                            "role": "user",
                            "content": "Reply with OK only. This is a service health check.",
                        }
                    ],
                    "temperature": 0,
                    "max_tokens": 1,
                    "stream": False,
                }
                timeout = httpx.Timeout(
                    self.config.llm_healthcheck_timeout_seconds,
                    connect=min(3.0, self.config.llm_healthcheck_timeout_seconds),
                )
                async with httpx.AsyncClient(
                    base_url=self.config.llm_base_url.rstrip("/"),
                    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.config.llm_api_key}"},
                    timeout=timeout,
                    transport=self._transport,
                    trust_env=False,
                ) as client:
                    response = await client.post("/chat/completions", json=payload)
                    response.raise_for_status()
                choices = response.json().get("choices")
                status = "ok" if isinstance(choices, list) and choices else "invalid_response"
            except httpx.HTTPStatusError as exc:
                status = "auth_error" if exc.response.status_code in (401, 403) else "upstream_error"
            except httpx.RequestError:
                status = "unreachable"
            except (TypeError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError):
                status = "invalid_response"
            finally:
                self._health_status = status
                self._health_checked_at = monotonic()
            return status

    async def complete_json(
        self,
        system_prompt: str,
        user_prompt: str,
        *,
        temperature: float = 0.2,
        max_tokens: int = 1600,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if not self.configured:
            raise RuntimeError("LLM_API_KEY is not configured")
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            "model": self.config.llm_model,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
                {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt},
            ],
            "temperature": temperature,
            "max_tokens": max_tokens,
            "stream": False,
        }
        if self.config.llm_json_mode:
            payload["response_format"] = {"type": "json_object"}
        async def request() -> httpx.Response:
            incr_event('llm_attempts', 'json')
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(
                base_url=self.config.llm_base_url.rstrip("/"),
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.config.llm_api_key}"},
                timeout=self.config.llm_timeout_seconds,
                transport=self._transport,
                trust_env=False,  # 本机环境变量会干扰连接，直接忽略系统代理与证书设置
            ) as client:
                response = await client.post("/chat/completions", json=payload)
                response.raise_for_status()
                return response

        response = await _with_retry(request)
        body = response.json()
        record_usage(body.get('usage'))
        content = body["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
        return self._parse_json(content)

    async def stream_text(
        self,
        system_prompt: str,
        messages: list[dict[str, str]],
        *,
        temperature: float = 0.7,
        max_tokens: int = 350,
    ) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
        if not self.configured:
            raise RuntimeError("LLM_API_KEY is not configured")
        payload = {
            "model": self.config.llm_model,
            "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": system_prompt}, *messages],
            "temperature": temperature,
            "max_tokens": max_tokens,
            "stream": True,
        }
        timeout = httpx.Timeout(
            self.config.llm_timeout_seconds,
            connect=min(3.0, self.config.llm_timeout_seconds),
        )
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(
            base_url=self.config.llm_base_url.rstrip("/"),
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.config.llm_api_key}"},
            timeout=timeout,
            transport=self._transport,
            trust_env=False,
        ) as client:
            incr_event('llm_attempts', 'stream')
            usage = None
            async with client.stream("POST", "/chat/completions", json=payload) as response:
                response.raise_for_status()
                async for line in response.aiter_lines():
                    if not line.startswith("data:"):
                        continue
                    raw = line[5:].strip()
                    if not raw or raw == "[DONE]":
                        continue
                    event = json.loads(raw)
                    if isinstance(event.get('usage'), dict):
                        usage = event['usage']
                    choices = event.get("choices") or []
                    if choices:
                        text = (choices[0].get("delta") or {}).get("content")
                        if text:
                            yield text
            record_usage(usage)

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_json(content: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        cleaned = content.strip()
        # Some compatible providers encode the JSON object as a JSON string.
        # Decode that envelope before looking for prose/Markdown wrappers.
        if cleaned.startswith('"'):
            envelope = json.loads(cleaned)
            if isinstance(envelope, str):
                cleaned = envelope.strip()
        fenced = re.search(r"```(?:json)?\s*(\{.*\})\s*```", cleaned, re.S)
        if fenced:
            cleaned = fenced.group(1)
        if not cleaned.startswith("{"):
            match = re.search(r"\{.*\}", cleaned, re.S)
            if match:
                cleaned = match.group(0)
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(cleaned)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            if not re.match(r'^\{(?:\s|\\[nrt])*\\"', cleaned):
                raise
            # Decode exactly one extra escaping layer, preserving quoted words
            # and backslashes inside values. Never repair truncated JSON.
            envelope = '"' + cleaned.replace('\r', '\\r').replace('\n', '\\n').replace('\t', '\\t') + '"'
            parsed = json.loads(json.loads(envelope))
        if not isinstance(parsed, dict):
            raise ValueError("Expected a JSON object from the model")
        return parsed


llm_gateway = LlmGateway()

"""邮件发送：忘记密码链接。

未配置 SMTP 时不报错，只记日志；调用方会回退到管理员工单，
这样本地开发和没有邮件服务的部署都能用。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

from app.core.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def smtp_configured() -> bool:
    return bool(settings.smtp_host and settings.smtp_from)


def _send_sync(to: str, subject: str, body: str) -> None:
    message = EmailMessage()
    message["From"] = settings.smtp_from
    message["To"] = to
    message["Subject"] = subject
    message.set_content(body)

    with smtplib.SMTP(settings.smtp_host, settings.smtp_port, timeout=15) as smtp:
        if settings.smtp_starttls:
            smtp.starttls()
        if settings.smtp_user and settings.smtp_password is not None:
            smtp.login(settings.smtp_user, settings.smtp_password.get_secret_value())
        smtp.send_message(message)


async def send_email(to: str, subject: str, body: str) -> bool:
    """通用发信；未配置 SMTP 时返回 False，由调用方决定回退策略。"""
    if not smtp_configured():
        logger.info("mail.skipped reason=smtp_not_configured to=%s", to)
        return False
    try:
        await asyncio.to_thread(_send_sync, to, subject, body)
        return True
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        logger.warning("mail.send_failed error_type=%s", type(exc).__name__)
        return False


async def send_password_reset(to: str, link: str, minutes: int) -> bool:
    if not smtp_configured():
        logger.info("mail.skipped reason=smtp_not_configured to=%s", to)
        return False
    subject = "言阶 · 重置密码"
    body = (
        "你好，\n\n"
        f"我们收到了重置言阶账号密码的请求。请在 {minutes} 分钟内打开下面的链接设置新密码：\n\n"
        f"{link}\n\n"
        "如果这不是你本人操作，忽略这封邮件即可，原密码不会改变。\n\n"
        "— 言阶"
    )
    try:
        await asyncio.to_thread(_send_sync, to, subject, body)
        return True
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        logger.warning("mail.send_failed error_type=%s", type(exc).__name__)
        return False

"""微课旁白合成。

优先级：豆包 seed-tts-2.0（支持情绪，国内网络稳定）→ edge-tts 神经声线 → 系统语音。
后者用 SSML 调语速与停顿，避免念稿感。任何一层失败都不影响整门课。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# 讲课时用的声线：晓晓偏自然口语，云希偏沉稳男声
VOICE_MAP = {
    "tutor": ("zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural", "+6%", "+2Hz"),
    "coach": ("zh-CN-YunxiNeural", "+4%", "+0Hz"),
    "female": ("zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural", "+4%", "+2Hz"),
}

ATTEMPTS = 4

# 豆包音色：kangkang 之外都是角色音色，适合讲课的是「天才同桌 / 爽朗少年」
DOUBAO_SPEAKERS = {
    "tutor": "saturn_zh_male_tiancaitongzhuo_tob",
    "coach": "saturn_zh_male_tiancaitongzhuo_tob",
    "female": "saturn_zh_female_bingjiaojiejie_tob",
}

DOUBAO_EMOTION = {
    "tutor": "gentle",
    "coach": "serious",
    "female": "gentle",
}

DOUBAO_URL = "https://openspeech.bytedance.com/api/v3/tts/unidirectional"


def _split_sentences(text: str, limit: int = 90) -> list[str]:
    """按标点切句，过短的片段并入上一句，让合成有自然停顿。"""
    cleaned = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
    if not cleaned:
        return []

    raw: list[str] = []
    buffer = ""
    for char in cleaned:
        buffer += char
        if char in "。！？；!?;":
            raw.append(buffer)
            buffer = ""
    if buffer.strip():
        raw.append(buffer)

    merged: list[str] = []
    for piece in (item.strip() for item in raw):
        if not piece:
            continue
        if merged and len(piece) < 6:
            merged[-1] += piece
        else:
            merged.append(piece)

    chunks: list[str] = []
    for piece in merged:
        while len(piece) > limit:
            chunks.append(piece[:limit])
            piece = piece[limit:]
        if piece:
            chunks.append(piece)
    return chunks


def _doubao_tts(text: str, out_wav: Path, style: str, emotion: str | None = None) -> None:
    """豆包大模型语音合成：一次请求返回若干段 mp3，拼接后转 wav。"""
    import base64
    import json
    import uuid

    import httpx

    from app.core.config import settings

    app_id = settings.doubao_tts_app_id or settings.doubao_realtime_app_id
    token = settings.doubao_tts_access_token or settings.doubao_realtime_access_token
    if not app_id or not token:
        raise RuntimeError("doubao tts not configured")

    speaker = settings.doubao_tts_speaker or DOUBAO_SPEAKERS.get(style, DOUBAO_SPEAKERS["tutor"])
    emotion = emotion or settings.doubao_tts_emotion or DOUBAO_EMOTION.get(style, "gentle")

    payload = {
        "user": {"uid": "yanjie"},
        "req_params": {
            "text": text,
            "speaker": speaker,
            "emotion": emotion,
            "audio_params": {"format": "mp3", "sample_rate": 24000, "speech_rate": 0},
        },
    }
    headers = {
        "X-Api-App-Id": app_id,
        "X-Api-Access-Key": token,
        "X-Api-Resource-Id": "seed-tts-2.0",
        "X-Api-Request-Id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    }

    mp3 = out_wav.with_suffix(".mp3")
    audio = bytearray()
    last_error: str | None = None
    with httpx.Client(timeout=60, trust_env=False) as client:
        response = client.post(DOUBAO_URL, json=payload, headers=headers)
        for line in response.text.splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            try:
                chunk = json.loads(line)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue
            if chunk.get("data"):
                audio.extend(base64.b64decode(chunk["data"]))
            code = chunk.get("code")
            if code not in (None, 0):
                last_error = str(chunk.get("message") or code)

    if len(audio) < 2048:
        raise RuntimeError(f"doubao tts empty: {last_error or response.status_code}")

    mp3.write_bytes(bytes(audio))
    # 直接交付 mp3：浏览器与 Remotion 都能播，省掉 ffmpeg 依赖
    mp3.replace(out_wav.with_suffix(".mp3"))


def _edge_tts(text: str, out_wav: Path, style: str) -> None:
    """用 edge-tts 命令行合成，避免在长驻进程里嵌套事件循环。"""
    import sys

    voice, rate, pitch = VOICE_MAP.get(style, VOICE_MAP["tutor"])
    mp3 = out_wav.with_suffix(".mp3")

    last: Exception | None = None
    for attempt in range(ATTEMPTS):
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                [
                    sys.executable,
                    "-m",
                    "edge_tts",
                    "--voice",
                    voice,
                    f"--rate={rate}",
                    f"--pitch={pitch}",
                    "--text",
                    text,
                    "--write-media",
                    str(mp3),
                ],
                capture_output=True,
                timeout=90,
            )
            if result.returncode != 0 or not mp3.is_file() or mp3.stat().st_size < 2048:
                raise RuntimeError(f"edge-tts exit={result.returncode}")
            return
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            last = exc
            mp3.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            logger.warning("narration.edge_retry attempt=%s error_type=%s", attempt + 1, type(exc).__name__)
            time.sleep(0.8 * (attempt + 1))
    raise RuntimeError(f"edge-tts failed: {type(last).__name__}")


def _system_tts(text: str, out_wav: Path, style: str = "tutor") -> None:
    """系统语音兜底：用 SSML 调语速、停顿和重音，避免念稿式的平铺直叙。"""
    sentences = _split_sentences(text) or [text]
    voice = "Microsoft Huihui Desktop"
    body: list[str] = []
    for index, sentence in enumerate(sentences):
        # 短句放慢、长句略快；相邻句子在音高上做一点起伏
        rate = "+8%" if len(sentence) <= 12 else "+2%" if len(sentence) <= 26 else "-2%"
        pitch = "+4%" if index % 2 == 0 else "+1%"
        emphasis = ' level="moderate"' if len(sentence) <= 18 else ""
        body.append(
            f'<prosody rate="{rate}" pitch="{pitch}">'
            f"<emphasis{emphasis}>{_escape(sentence)}</emphasis>"
            "</prosody><break time=\"220ms\"/>"
        )
    ssml = (
        '<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN">'
        f'<voice name="{voice}">' + "".join(body) + "</voice></speak>"
    )

    workdir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
    ssml_file = workdir / "ssml.xml"
    ssml_file.write_text(ssml, encoding="utf-8")
    script = workdir / "tts.ps1"
    script.write_text(
        "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech\n"
        "$s = New-Object System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer\n"
        f"$s.SetOutputToWaveFile('{out_wav.as_posix()}')\n"
        f"$xml = Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 '{ssml_file.as_posix()}'\n"
        "$s.SpeakSsml($xml)\n"
        "$s.Dispose()\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    subprocess.run(
        ["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", str(script)],
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
    )


def _escape(text: str) -> str:
    return (
        text.replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">").replace('"', """)
    )


def audio_duration(path: Path) -> float:
    """读取音频时长（mp3 或 wav）。"""
    from mutagen import File as MutagenFile

    audio = MutagenFile(str(path))
    if audio is None or audio.info is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"cannot read duration: {path.name}")
    return float(audio.info.length)


def synthesize_slide(
    text: str, workdir: Path, index: int, style: str = "tutor", emotion: str | None = None,
    *, split_text: bool = True,
) -> tuple[Path, float, str]:
    """合成一幕旁白，返回（音频文件, 秒数, 引擎）。"""
    sentences = (_split_sentences(text) or [text]) if split_text else [text]
    pieces: list[Path] = []
    engine = "doubao"

    for position, sentence in enumerate(sentences):
        base = workdir / f"slide-{index}-part{position}"
        piece: Path | None = None
        for provider, label in (("doubao", "doubao"), ("edge", "edge"), ("system", "system")):
            try:
                if provider == "doubao":
                    target = base.with_suffix(".mp3")
                    _doubao_tts(sentence, target, style, emotion)
                elif provider == "edge":
                    target = base.with_suffix(".mp3")
                    _edge_tts(sentence, target, style)
                else:
                    target = base.with_suffix(".wav")
                    _system_tts(sentence, target, style)
                if target.is_file() and target.stat().st_size > 512:
                    piece = target
                    engine = label if not pieces else engine
                    break
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                logger.warning("narration.%s_failed error_type=%s", provider, type(exc).__name__)
        if piece:
            pieces.append(piece)

    if not pieces:
        raise RuntimeError("no narration audio produced")

    merged = workdir / f"slide-{index}{pieces[0].suffix}"
    merged.write_bytes(b"".join(piece.read_bytes() for piece in pieces))
    for piece in pieces:
        piece.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return merged, audio_duration(merged), engine

import asyncio
import ipaddress
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass

from fastapi import Request
from redis.asyncio import Redis

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.errors import AppError


@dataclass(slots=True)
class MemoryCounter:
    count: int
    expires_at: float


class RateLimiter:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        redis_password = (
            settings.redis_password.get_secret_value() if settings.redis_password else None
        )
        self._redis = Redis.from_url(
            settings.redis_url,
            password=redis_password,
            decode_responses=True,
        )
        self._remote_available = False
        self._memory: dict[str, MemoryCounter] = {}
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def initialize(self) -> None:
        if not settings.redis_enabled:
            return
        try:
            await self._redis.ping()
            self._remote_available = True
        except Exception:
            self._remote_available = False

    async def check(self, key: str, limit: int, window_seconds: int) -> None:
        count, retry_after = await self._increment(key, window_seconds)
        if count > limit:
            raise AppError(
                429,
                "RATE_LIMITED",
                "请求过于频繁，请稍后再试",
                headers={"Retry-After": str(max(1, retry_after))},
            )

    async def _increment(self, key: str, window_seconds: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
        namespaced = f"rate:{key}"
        if self._remote_available:
            try:
                result = await self._redis.eval(
                    """
                    local count = redis.call('INCR', KEYS[1])
                    if count == 1 then redis.call('EXPIRE', KEYS[1], ARGV[1]) end
                    return {count, redis.call('TTL', KEYS[1])}
                    """,
                    1,
                    namespaced,
                    window_seconds,
                )
                return int(result[0]), int(result[1])
            except Exception:
                self._remote_available = False

        now = time.monotonic()
        async with self._lock:
            current = self._memory.get(namespaced)
            if current is None or current.expires_at <= now:
                current = MemoryCounter(count=0, expires_at=now + window_seconds)
                self._memory[namespaced] = current
            current.count += 1
            retry_after = int(max(1, current.expires_at - now))
            if len(self._memory) > 10_000:
                self._memory = {
                    name: item for name, item in self._memory.items() if item.expires_at > now
                }
            return current.count, retry_after

    async def close(self) -> None:
        await self._redis.aclose()

    @property
    def mode(self) -> str:
        return "redis" if self._remote_available else "memory"


def resolve_client_ip(
    xff_value: str | None,
    peer_host: str | None,
    trusted_proxy_count: int,
) -> str:
    """XFF 形如「客户端, 代理1, 代理2」，只有确认了可信跳数才能从右侧数着取。

    trusted_proxy_count 为 0（默认）时不信任任何代理头，直接回落到 TCP 对端地址；
    否则取右侧第 trusted_proxy_count 跳——左侧条目完全由客户端控制，取它等于让攻击者自选限流键。
    跳数不够、条目为空或不是合法 IP 时同样回落到对端地址。
    """
    peer = (peer_host or "").strip() or "unknown"
    if trusted_proxy_count <= 0:
        return peer
    hops = [item.strip() for item in (xff_value or "").split(",")]
    if len(hops) < trusted_proxy_count:
        return peer
    candidate = hops[-trusted_proxy_count]
    try:
        ipaddress.ip_address(candidate)
    except ValueError:
        return peer
    return candidate


def client_identifier(request: Request) -> str:
    return resolve_client_ip(
        request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-For"),
        request.client.host if request.client else None,
        settings.trusted_proxy_count,
    )

async def limit_model_user(user_id: str) -> None:

    from app.core import metrics
    from app.core.errors import AppError

    await rate_limiter.check(f"model:{user_id}", 30, 60)

def _today() -> str:
    from datetime import datetime, timezone

    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).date().isoformat()


async def _daily_calls(user_id: str) -> int:
    from sqlalchemy import select

    from app.db.base import session_factory
    from app.db.models import ModelUsageDaily

    async with session_factory() as session:
        row = await session.get(ModelUsageDaily, {"user_id": user_id, "day": _today()})
        return int(row.calls) if row else 0


async def _record_usage(user_id: str) -> None:
    from sqlalchemy import update
    from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError

    from app.db.base import session_factory
    from app.db.models import ModelUsageDaily, now

    day = _today()
    async with session_factory() as session:
        row = await session.get(ModelUsageDaily, {"user_id": user_id, "day": day})
        if row is None:
            session.add(ModelUsageDaily(user_id=user_id, day=day, calls=1))
        else:
            row.calls = int(row.calls) + 1
        try:
            await session.commit()
        except IntegrityError:
            # 同一用户并发请求会同时插入，退化为原子 UPDATE
            await session.rollback()
            await session.execute(
                update(ModelUsageDaily)
                .where(ModelUsageDaily.user_id == user_id, ModelUsageDaily.day == day)
                .values(calls=ModelUsageDaily.calls + 1, updated_at=now())
            )
            await session.commit()

def _token_subject(request: Request) -> str | None:
    """从 Bearer Token 里取用户 ID，仅用于留痕；无效 token 返回 None。"""
    header = request.headers.get("authorization") or ""
    if not header.lower().startswith("bearer "):
        return None
    token = header[7:].strip()
    try:
        import jwt as pyjwt

        payload = pyjwt.decode(
            token,
            settings.jwt_secret,
            algorithms=[settings.jwt_algorithm],
            audience=settings.jwt_audience,
            issuer=settings.jwt_issuer,
            options={"require": ["sub", "exp", "iss", "aud", "iat"]},
        )
        subject = payload.get("sub")
        return subject if isinstance(subject, str) else None
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return None


def _first_path_param(request: Request) -> str | None:
    params = request.scope.get("path_params") or {}
    for key in ("scene_id", "user_id", "course_id", "task_id", "request_id", "session_id"):
        value = params.get(key)
        if value:
            return str(value)
    return None

@app.middleware("http")
async def request_id_middleware(request: Request, call_next):
    request.state.request_id = request.headers.get("X-Request-Id") or str(uuid4())
    started = perf_counter()
    response = await call_next(request)
    response.headers["X-Request-Id"] = request.state.request_id
    response.headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff"
    response.headers["X-Frame-Options"] = "DENY"
    response.headers["Referrer-Policy"] = "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
    response.headers["Permissions-Policy"] = "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()"
    response.headers["Content-Security-Policy"] = "default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'"
    if settings.environment == "production":
        response.headers["Strict-Transport-Security"] = "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains"
    elapsed = perf_counter() - started
    route = getattr(request.scope.get("route"), "path", None) or "unmatched"
    if request.url.path != "/metrics":
        metrics.observe_request(request.method, route, response.status_code, elapsed)
    if (
        request.url.path.startswith(f"{settings.api_prefix}/admin")
        and request.method in audit.MUTATING
        and response.status_code < 400
    ):
        await audit.record(
            actor_id=_token_subject(request),
            actor_email=None,
            method=request.method,
            route=route,
            status=response.status_code,
            target_id=_first_path_param(request),
            ip=(request.client.host if request.client else None),
            request_id=request.state.request_id,
        )
    logger.info(
        "request.completed",
        extra={
            "request_id": request.state.request_id,
            "method": request.method,
            "path": request.url.path,
            "route": route,
            "status_code": response.status_code,
            "duration_ms": round(elapsed * 1000, 2),
        },
    )
    return response

def database_url() -> str:
    command_line = context.get_x_argument(as_dictionary=True).get("database_url")

    return command_line or configured or settings.database_url


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    url = database_url()
    context.configure(
        url=url,
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
        compare_type=True,
        render_as_batch=url.startswith("sqlite"),
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def do_run_migrations(connection: Connection) -> None:
    context.configure(
        connection=connection,
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        compare_type=True,
        render_as_batch=connection.dialect.name == "sqlite",
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


async def run_async_migrations() -> None:
    configuration = config.get_section(config.config_ini_section, {})
    configuration["sqlalchemy.url"] = database_url()
    connectable = async_engine_from_config(
        configuration,
        prefix="sqlalchemy.",
        poolclass=pool.NullPool,
    )
    async with connectable.connect() as connection:
        await connection.run_sync(do_run_migrations)
    await connectable.dispose()


def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    asyncio.run(run_async_migrations())


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()

from copy import deepcopy

LABELS = {"逻辑性": "内容与逻辑", "针对性": "贴合问题", "正确性": "信息完整", "感染力": "信息完整", "简洁度": "表达干净", "得体性": "表达干净"}
DEFAULTS = (("course", "COURSE"), ("practice", "TRAINING"), ("rewrite", "REWRITE"), ("retest", "RETEST"))


def upgrade_tasks(raw_tasks, focus, course, sources, active):
    tasks = deepcopy(raw_tasks or [])
    baseline = next((t.get("sourceSessionId") for t in tasks if t.get("sourceSessionId") in sources), None)
    for index, task in enumerate(tasks):
        key, action = DEFAULTS[min(index, len(DEFAULTS)-1)]
        task.setdefault("key", key)
        task.setdefault("actionType", action)
        task.setdefault("day", 1)
        task.setdefault("task", "查看本次训练内容")
        task.setdefault("completed", False)
        task.setdefault("completedAt", None)
        task.setdefault("evidence", None)
        if task.get("dimension") in LABELS:
            task["dimension"] = LABELS[task["dimension"]]
        if task["actionType"] in {"REWRITE", "RETEST", "TRAINING"}:
            source_id = task.get("sourceSessionId") or baseline
            source = sources.get(source_id)
            task["sourceSessionId"] = source_id if source else None
            if source:
                task.setdefault("sceneId", source["scene_id"])
                task.setdefault("channel", source["channel"] or "TEXT")
                task.setdefault("depth", source["depth"] or "STANDARD")
            elif not source_id:
                task["sourceUnavailable"] = True
        if task["actionType"] == "REWRITE":
            task.setdefault("rewriteFeedback", None)
            task.setdefault("rewritePassed", bool(task["completed"]))
            task.setdefault("rewriteDegraded", False)
        if task["actionType"] == "COURSE":
            task.setdefault("courseId", course["id"] if course else None)
            if not task.get("lesson"):
                principles = [p.strip() for p in (course["content"] if course else "结论先行；使用事实；明确下一步").replace("；", ";").split(";") if p.strip()]
                principles += ["给出具体事实并明确下一步"] * 3
                task["lesson"] = {"title": course["title"] if course else f"{focus}沟通技巧", "intro": f"围绕{focus}完成三个小步骤，再用自己的语言作答。当前为离线示例内容。", "steps": [{"title": f"第 {n+1} 步：{p}", "explanation": f"在下一次面试表达中练习“{p}”，并检查听众是否能抓住重点。", "example": f"示例：我先说明当前情况，再说明{p}，最后确认下一步行动。"} for n,p in enumerate(principles[:3])], "exercise": f"请结合最近一次真实沟通，用上述三个方法重写一段至少 40 字的{focus}表达。"}
                task.setdefault("completedSteps", [0,1,2] if task["completed"] else [])
                task.setdefault("practicePassed", bool(task["completed"]))
            task.setdefault("completedSteps", [])
            task.setdefault("practiceAnswer", None)
            task.setdefault("practiceFeedback", None)
            task.setdefault("practicePassed", False)
            task.setdefault("practiceDegraded", False)
    if active and baseline and not any(t["actionType"] == "RETEST" for t in tasks):
        source = sources[baseline]
        tasks.append({"key":"retest", "day":2, "task":"按原场景条件复测，对比四维变化", "actionType":"RETEST", "sceneId":source["scene_id"], "sourceSessionId":baseline, "channel":source["channel"] or "TEXT", "depth":source["depth"] or "STANDARD", "completed":False, "completedAt":None, "evidence":None})
    return tasks

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.append(str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

import yaml  # noqa: E402
from sqlalchemy import select  # noqa: E402

from app.db.base import session_factory  # noqa: E402
from app.db.models import Scene  # noqa: E402
from app.features.scenes.bank import build_bank  # noqa: E402


async def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="导出题库")
    parser.add_argument("--out", default="content/scene-bank.yaml")
    parser.add_argument("--active-only", action="store_true", help="只导出已开放场景")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    async with session_factory() as session:
        query = select(Scene).order_by(Scene.category, Scene.title)
        if args.active_only:
            query = query.where(Scene.active.is_(True))
        scenes = list((await session.scalars(query)).all())

    payload = build_bank(scenes)
    target = Path(args.out)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(payload, allow_unicode=True, sort_keys=False), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"已导出 {payload['count']} 个场景到 {target}")


if __name__ == "__main__":

    asyncio.run(main())

"""从 YAML 导入题库：按标题新建或更新。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.append(str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

import yaml  # noqa: E402
from sqlalchemy import select  # noqa: E402

from app.db.base import session_factory  # noqa: E402
from app.db.models import Scene  # noqa: E402
from app.features.scenes.bank import validate_scene  # noqa: E402


async def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="导入题库")
    parser.add_argument("--file", default="content/scene-bank.yaml")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--update", action="store_true", help="已存在同名场景时更新内容")
    parser.add_argument("--active", action="store_true", help="新建场景直接开放")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    source = Path(args.file)
    if not source.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f"找不到文件：{source}")

    payload = yaml.safe_load(source.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or {}
    entries = payload.get("scenes") or []
    created, updated, skipped = 0, 0, 0
    problems: list[str] = []

    async with session_factory() as session:
        existing = {scene.title: scene for scene in (await session.scalars(select(Scene))).all()}
        for raw in entries:
            scene_data, issues = validate_scene(raw)
            problems.extend(issues)
            if scene_data is None:
                skipped += 1
                continue

            current = existing.get(scene_data["title"])
            if current is not None:
                if not args.update:
                    skipped += 1
                    problems.append(f"{scene_data['title']} 已存在，跳过（用 --update 覆盖）")
                    continue
                for key in ("category", "difficulty", "role_name", "background", "goal", "opening_line", "tags", "question_bank"):
                    setattr(current, key, scene_data[key])
                updated += 1
                continue

            session.add(
                Scene(
                    category=scene_data["category"],
                    industry="综合行业",
                    position="通用岗位",
                    role_name=scene_data["role_name"],
                    difficulty=scene_data["difficulty"],
                    background=scene_data["background"],
                    goal=scene_data["goal"],
                    tags=scene_data["tags"],
                    opening_line=scene_data["opening_line"],
                    question_bank=scene_data["question_bank"],
                    active=args.active,
                )
            )
            created += 1

        if args.dry_run:
            await session.rollback()
        else:
            await session.commit()

    print(f"新建 {created} 个，更新 {updated} 个，跳过 {skipped} 个{'（dry-run，未写库）' if args.dry_run else ''}")
    for problem in problems[:10]:
        print("  提示:", problem)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import asyncio

    asyncio.run(main())

"""清掉库里残留的旧维度文案。

处理三类：
1. 计划里的微课（lesson）含旧维度词 → 重新生成；
2. 评分摘要 / 建议含旧词 → 按新维度做文本替换；
3. 课程维度仍是旧命名 → 映射到四维。

视频缓存由调用方在结束后清理（内容变了，哈希也会变）。
"""

import asyncio
import copy
import json

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm.attributes import flag_modified

from app.core.legacy_text import modernize
from app.db.base import session_factory
from app.db.models import Course, Evaluation, TrainingPlan
from app.features.plans.service import personalized_lesson

LEGACY_WORDS = ("逻辑性", "得体性", "正确性", "针对性", "简洁度", "感染力", "五维")

COURSE_DIMENSION_MAP = {
    "逻辑性": "内容与逻辑",
    "针对性": "贴合问题",
    "正确性": "信息完整",
    "感染力": "信息完整",
    "简洁度": "表达干净",
    "得体性": "表达干净",
}


def has_legacy(value) -> bool:
    text = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False) if not isinstance(value, str) else value
    return any(word in text for word in LEGACY_WORDS)


async def main() -> None:
    regenerated = 0
    rewritten = 0
    courses_fixed = 0

    async with session_factory() as session:
        plans = list((await session.scalars(select(TrainingPlan))).all())

        # 第一遍：修正计划自身的维度与文案（提交后再动微课，避免拿着旧副本覆盖结果）
        for plan in plans:
            mapped = COURSE_DIMENSION_MAP.get(plan.focus_dimension)
            if mapped and mapped != plan.focus_dimension:
                plan.focus_dimension = mapped
                courses_fixed += 1
            if plan.title and has_legacy(plan.title):
                plan.title = modernize(plan.title)
                rewritten += 1
            tasks = copy.deepcopy(plan.tasks or [])
            touched = False
            for task in tasks:
                if task.get("task") and has_legacy(task.get("task")):
                    task["task"] = modernize(task["task"])
                    touched = True
                    rewritten += 1
            if touched:
                plan.tasks = tasks
                flag_modified(plan, "tasks")
        await session.commit()

        # 第二遍：重新生成含旧词的微课
        for plan in plans:
            for task in plan.tasks or []:
                lesson = task.get("lesson")
                if lesson and has_legacy(lesson):
                    try:
                        await personalized_lesson(session, plan.user_id, plan.id, task.get("key", "course"), force=True)
                        regenerated += 1
                        print(f"  重生成微课 plan={plan.id[:8]} task={task.get('key')}")
                    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                        print(f"  重生成失败 plan={plan.id[:8]}: {type(exc).__name__}")

        # 第三遍：任务文案与微课标题对齐（历史任务文案里写的是旧标题）
        for plan in plans:
            tasks = copy.deepcopy(plan.tasks or [])
            touched = False
            for task in tasks:
                lesson = task.get("lesson") or {}
                if task.get("actionType") == "COURSE" and lesson.get("title"):
                    expected = f"学习微课《{lesson['title']}》，按三个步骤完成表达练习"
                    if task.get("task") != expected:
                        task["task"] = expected
                        touched = True
            if touched:
                plan.tasks = tasks
                flag_modified(plan, "tasks")
        await session.commit()

        for evaluation in (await session.scalars(select(Evaluation))).all():
            if has_legacy(evaluation.summary or ""):
                evaluation.summary = modernize(evaluation.summary)
                rewritten += 1
            if evaluation.suggestions and has_legacy(evaluation.suggestions):
                evaluation.suggestions = modernize(evaluation.suggestions)
                rewritten += 1

        for course in (await session.scalars(select(Course))).all():
            mapped = COURSE_DIMENSION_MAP.get(course.dimension)
            if mapped and mapped != course.dimension:
                course.dimension = mapped
                courses_fixed += 1

        await session.commit()

    print(f"微课重生成 {regenerated} 门，文本替换 {rewritten} 处，课程维度修正 {courses_fixed} 条")


asyncio.run(main())

"""清理"啥也没干"的空训练会话：0 轮、没有用户回答、没有评分、也没有消息的占位记录。

进面试房间时前端会先 POST /training-sessions/prepare 建一条占位会话（只带一句开场白）。
正常退出会 discard，异常退出（关标签页、断网、旧版本前端）就留在库里，训练记录页会把它当
"进行中 0/12 轮"列出来。本脚本兜底清理这些占位记录。

判定条件（全部满足才删）：
  status = ACTIVE、current_round = 0、无 Evaluation、无任何用户/对话消息
  （prepare 自动写入的 round_no=0 开场白不算用户数据）、创建超过 --minutes 分钟（默认 30）。

用法：
  python -m scripts.cleanup_empty_sessions --dry-run   # 只看会删哪些
  python -m scripts.cleanup_empty_sessions             # 真删
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from sqlalchemy import delete, func, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.db.base import session_factory
from app.db.models import Evaluation, Message, ResumeContext, TrainingSession

DEFAULT_MINUTES = 30
SAMPLE_SIZE = 5


def cutoff_time(minutes: int) -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(minutes=minutes)


def aware(value: datetime | None) -> datetime | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value if value.tzinfo else value.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)


async def collect_targets(session: AsyncSession, cutoff: datetime) -> list[TrainingSession]:
    """空占位会话：0 轮、未开始、没有用户内容、也没有评分。"""
    answered = select(Message.session_id).where(Message.round_no > 0).union_all(
        select(Message.session_id).where(Message.speaker == "USER")
    )
    scored = select(Evaluation.session_id)
    rows = (
        await session.scalars(
            select(TrainingSession)
            .where(
                TrainingSession.status == "ACTIVE",
                TrainingSession.current_round == 0,
                TrainingSession.id.notin_(answered),
                TrainingSession.id.notin_(scored),
            )
            .order_by(TrainingSession.started_at)
        )
    ).all()
    return [item for item in rows if (aware(item.started_at) or cutoff) <= cutoff]


async def run(dry_run: bool, minutes: int) -> dict:
    cutoff = cutoff_time(minutes)
    async with session_factory() as session:
        targets = await collect_targets(session, cutoff)
        ids = [item.id for item in targets]
        print(f"cutoff={cutoff.isoformat()} minutes={minutes} matched={len(ids)}")
        for session_id in ids[:SAMPLE_SIZE]:
            print(f"  candidate: {session_id}")
        if dry_run:
            print("dry-run: nothing deleted")
            return {"matched": len(ids), "deleted": 0, "ids": ids}
        if ids:
            await session.execute(delete(Message).where(Message.session_id.in_(ids)))
            await session.execute(delete(ResumeContext).where(ResumeContext.session_id.in_(ids)))
            await session.execute(delete(TrainingSession).where(TrainingSession.id.in_(ids)))
            await session.commit()
        remaining = await session.scalar(
            select(func.count())
            .select_from(TrainingSession)
            .where(TrainingSession.status == "ACTIVE", TrainingSession.current_round == 0)
        )
        print(f"deleted={len(ids)} remaining_empty_active={int(remaining or 0)}")
        return {"matched": len(ids), "deleted": len(ids), "ids": ids, "remaining": int(remaining or 0)}


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> dict:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="清理 0 轮空占位训练会话")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="只列出会删哪些，不落库")
    parser.add_argument("--minutes", type=int, default=DEFAULT_MINUTES, help="只清理创建超过多少分钟的会话")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    return asyncio.run(run(dry_run=args.dry_run, minutes=args.minutes))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""导出一批评分证据，供人工标注打分。

用法：

    python scripts/export_annotation_batch.py --size 40 --out annotation.csv

生成的 CSV 每行对应「一条证据（某个维度、某一轮）」，其中 human_score 留空待填，
填好后再跑 scripts/score_agreement.py 计算一致性。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import csv
import random
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.append(str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from sqlalchemy import select  # noqa: E402

from app.db.base import session_factory  # noqa: E402
from app.db.models import Evaluation, EvaluationEvidence, Message, TrainingSession  # noqa: E402

LABELS = {
    "logic": "内容与逻辑",
    "relevance": "贴合问题",
    "correctness": "信息完整",
    "concision": "表达干净",
}
SCORE_FIELD = {
    "logic": "logic_score",
    "relevance": "relevance_score",
    "correctness": "correctness_score",
    "concision": "concision_score",
}


async def collect(size: int) -> list[dict]:
    async with session_factory() as session:
        rows = (
            await session.execute(
                select(EvaluationEvidence, Evaluation, Message, TrainingSession)
                .join(Evaluation, Evaluation.id == EvaluationEvidence.evaluation_id)
                .join(Message, Message.id == EvaluationEvidence.answer_message_id)
                .join(TrainingSession, TrainingSession.id == Evaluation.session_id)
                .where(Evaluation.degraded.is_(False))
            )
        ).all()
        question_ids = {row[0].question_message_id for row in rows if row[0].question_message_id}
        questions = {
            message.id: message.content
            for message in (
                await session.scalars(select(Message).where(Message.id.in_(question_ids)))
            ).all()
        } if question_ids else {}

    pool: list[dict] = []
    for evidence, evaluation, message, training in rows:
        dimension = evidence.dimension if evidence.dimension in SCORE_FIELD else None
        if dimension is None:
            continue
        pool.append(
            {
                "session_id": evaluation.session_id,
                "round_no": evidence.round_no,
                "dimension": LABELS[dimension],
                "dimension_key": dimension,
                "question": questions.get(evidence.question_message_id, ""),
                "answer": message.content,
                "quote": evidence.quote,
                "model_score": getattr(evaluation, SCORE_FIELD[dimension]),
                "channel": training.channel,
                "human_score": "",
                "note": "",
            }
        )

    # 按维度轮流抽样，保证四维都有样本
    random.seed(20261102)
    by_dimension: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for row in pool:
        by_dimension.setdefault(row["dimension"], []).append(row)
    selected: list[dict] = []
    keys = list(by_dimension)
    while len(selected) < size and any(by_dimension.values()):
        for key in keys:
            bucket = by_dimension[key]
            if bucket and len(selected) < size:
                selected.append(bucket.pop(random.randrange(len(bucket))))
    return selected


async def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="导出人工标注样本")
    parser.add_argument("--size", type=int, default=40)
    parser.add_argument("--out", default="annotation.csv")
    parser.add_argument("--blind", action="store_true", help="按完整报告导出四维盲评；size 表示报告数")
    parser.add_argument("--email", default=None, help="只导出指定账号的数据")
    parser.add_argument("--key-out", default="", help="盲评模型分对照文件，必须与标注表分开保存")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if not 1 <= args.size <= 200:
        raise SystemExit("size 必须在 1–200 之间")
    if args.blind:
        from app.features.evaluations.blind_study import collect_blind
        async with session_factory() as db:
            annotations, key = await collect_blind(db, args.size, args.email)
        if not annotations:
            raise SystemExit("没有符合正式评分条件的完整报告，不能生成盲评材料")
        target = Path(args.out)
        key_target = Path(args.key_out) if args.key_out else target.with_name(target.stem + "-model-key.csv")
        if target.resolve() == key_target.resolve():
            raise SystemExit("盲评表与模型对照表不能使用同一路径")
        for path, values in ((target, annotations), (key_target, key)):
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as handle:
                writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=list(values[0]))
                writer.writeheader()
                writer.writerows(values)
        print(f"已准备 {len(annotations) // 4} 份独立报告、{len(annotations)} 条维度盲评，人工分数留空。")
        print(f"标注表：{target.resolve()}\n模型对照表（不交给盲评者）：{key_target.resolve()}")
        return

    rows = await collect(args.size)
    if not rows:
        print("没有可导出的证据（需要非降级评分记录）")
        return

    target = Path(args.out)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fields = ["session_id", "round_no", "dimension", "question", "answer", "quote", "model_score", "human_score", "note"]
    with target.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as handle:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=fields)
        writer.writeheader()
        for row in rows:
            writer.writerow({key: row.get(key, "") for key in fields})

    print(f"已导出 {len(rows)} 条到 {target.resolve()}")
    print("下一步：用 Excel 打开，填写 human_score（1-5 整数），然后运行：")
    print(f"    python scripts/score_agreement.py --input {target.name}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

"""批量生成面试场景（草稿），生成后默认不对外开放，由管理员审核。

用法示例：

    # 预览 3 个 HR 初面场景，不写库
